caption: Process
description: Extends the process object to add Windows specific fields.

token_elevation_type.description: The User Account Control elevation type of the access token that the process runs with, normalized to the caption of the token_elevation_type_id value. In the case of 'Other', it is defined by the event source.

token_elevation_type_id.description: The normalized identifier of the User Account Control elevation type of the access token that the process runs with.
